editions.title: Open-source church check-in
editions.tagline: A kids check-in kiosk for your church. Parents check children in on a tablet and get a pickup code; your children's ministry team sees who is in the room right now.
editions.description: Open-source church check-in: a kids check-in kiosk with pickup codes, a live roster, and attendance charts. Self-hosted on Cloudflare, 12 interface languages. A Church4Christ edition.
features: **Self-serve kiosk on any tablet browser.** A parent searches by a child's name or their own phone number, taps the children they are dropping off, and checks in.
**Pickup codes instead of badge printers.** Each check-in gets a 4-character code shown on screen; siblings checked in together share one code, and the code guards checkout.
**A live roster for staff.** The Today tab lists every check-in with its code and times, with one-click staff checkout when a parent has lost the code.
**Real numbers.** The dashboard shows this week's count, a 4-week average, distinct children this month, and a 12-week attendance chart.
**Your classes, your schedule.** Add a class or service, optionally tied to a weekday; retiring one removes it from the kiosk and keeps its history.
**Lost tablet? Regenerate the link.** The kiosk runs from a private URL; regenerating it shuts the old device out immediately.
**Families come from People & Households.** Every child recorded under a household can check in; CSV import brings your existing family list in.
**12 interface languages**, including English and Chinese; each church picks the ones it offers.
limits: There is no label printing; the pickup code is shown on screen.

Only children recorded in a household check in. Adult service headcounts come from the separate Service Attendance feature, which uses the service types from Volunteer Scheduling; turn both on later in **Settings → Modules** if you want combined adult and child totals.

zh.title: 开源教会儿童报到系统
zh.summary: 家长在平板上为孩子报到，拿到接送码；儿童事工同工随时看到现在谁在教室里。
features: 自助报到机：任何平板浏览器都能用，按孩子姓名或家长电话查找家庭。
接送码取代打印标签：兄弟姐妹共用一个 4 位码，凭码接走孩子。
同工管理台：今日实时名单、12 周出席图表、班级管理。
平板丢失可一键重新生成报到链接，旧设备立即失效。
家庭资料来自「会友与家庭」，可用 CSV 导入现有名单。
支持 12 种界面语言（含中英文），教会自选要开启的语言。

editions.title: Open-source church volunteer scheduling
editions.tagline: Schedule worship, kids, hospitality, and tech teams. Volunteers confirm or decline from an email link, block out dates, and subscribe to their serving calendar.
editions.description: Open-source church volunteer scheduling: teams, positions, a monthly scheduling matrix, confirm/decline emails, blockout dates, and a spiritual gifts quiz. Self-hosted, 12 interface languages. A Church4Christ edition.
features: **Ministries, teams, positions, and plans.** A ministry holds teams, a team defines its positions, and a plan is one dated service. A new-ministry wizard sets up a whole area in a few minutes.
**A scheduling matrix.** Fill a month at a glance; the site warns when someone is already booked that day or has a blockout.
**Confirm or decline from email.** Each assignment sends a single-use link, no sign-in needed. A decline emails the team's leaders right away.
**Open slots, blockouts, and availability.** Volunteers claim open slots and mark single days, ranges, or repeating dates away; leaders see who is free across upcoming plans.
**Plans generated ahead.** Copy a service's needs forward week by week, up to about a year.
**Reminders and a weekly digest.** Unconfirmed volunteers get a reminder before their service, and everyone gets a weekly list of their serving.
**Personal schedule and calendar feed.** Each volunteer has a schedule page and a private subscribe link for Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, or Outlook.
**Apply to serve and a spiritual gifts quiz.** An opportunity board, team applications that leaders approve, and a 40-statement gifts quiz that recommends ministries.
**12 interface languages** throughout, including English and Chinese.
limits: Reminder, digest, and confirm/decline emails need an email provider when deployed; on your own computer, emails print to the terminal instead of being sent.
Scheduling is per position on dated plans; there is no automatic rotation algorithm that assigns people for you.

screenshots.alt: The scheduling matrix: plans down one axis, positions across the other
A plan with every position and each volunteer's status
The volunteer's serve page with upcoming assignments and open slots
Spiritual gifts quiz results with ministry recommendations

editions.demo: Choose **Administrator**, then open the **Volunteer Console** in the admin menu. Choose **Member portal** to see the volunteer side: the **Serve** page and the gifts quiz.

zh.title: 开源教会服事排班系统
zh.summary: 为敬拜、儿童、招待、音控等团队排班；同工从邮件链接确认或婉拒，标记不能服事的日期，并订阅自己的服事日历。
features: 事工 → 团队 → 岗位 → 排班计划，新事工向导几分钟建好。
月度排班矩阵，自动提示重复安排和请假冲突。
同工从邮件一键确认或婉拒，无需登录；婉拒会立即通知组长。
空缺认领、请假日期、可服事情况一览。
自动提醒和每周服事摘要，个人日历可订阅到 Apple / Google / Outlook。
申请服事、机会看板，以及 40 题恩赐测验推荐适合的事工。

editions.title: Open-source small group management for churches
editions.tagline: A home for your church's small groups: a public directory, join requests, recurring meetings, and attendance taken from an emailed checklist.
editions.description: Open-source small group management for churches: public and private groups, join requests, group leaders, recurring meetings, and attendance tracking. Self-hosted, 12 interface languages. A Church4Christ edition.
features: **Public and private groups.** Public groups appear in the directory; private groups are invisible to anyone who is not a member.
**Join requests.** A visitor signs in with just a name and email (magic link, no password) and taps Request to join; a group leader approves or declines.
**Group leaders run their own group.** Roster, requests, the public/private switch, and meetings all live on one manage page, with no admin-area access needed.
**Members without email still count.** Add someone by name only; add an email later and they get a real profile.
**Recurring meetings.** Weekly, every other week, or monthly meetings are put on the calendar automatically.
**Attendance without homework.** After a tracked meeting, leaders get an email link to a simple checklist; tick who came and save.
**Involvement history.** Each person's profile shows their groups and attendance.
**A fellowship directory** for larger fellowships alongside small groups.
**12 interface languages** throughout, including English and Chinese.
limits: Paid or open sign-up events for a group use the Registration feature, which needs the optional Supabase database. This edition runs on the default Cloudflare D1 database, where that section simply does not appear.
Attendance emails need an email provider when deployed; on your own computer they print to the terminal.

screenshots.alt: Creating groups and assigning group leaders
The attendance checklist a group leader fills in after a meeting

editions.demo: Open **Groups** in the site menu to see the public directory, then choose **Administrator** and open **Groups** in the admin menu.

zh.title: 开源教会小组管理系统
zh.summary: 为教会小组建一个家：公开小组目录、加入申请、定期聚会，聚会后用邮件里的清单点名。
features: 公开或私密小组，私密小组对非成员完全不可见。
访客用姓名和邮箱登录（无需密码）即可申请加入，组长审核。
组长自己管理名单、申请和聚会，不需要后台权限。
没有邮箱的成员也能只用姓名加入。
每周、隔周或每月的定期聚会自动排进日历。
聚会结束后组长收到点名清单链接，勾选即可。
附带团契目录；支持 12 种界面语言。

editions.title: Open-source church website CMS
editions.tagline: A multilingual church website your staff can update without a developer: sermons, events, bulletins, articles, prayer requests, and a block page builder.
editions.description: Open-source church website CMS: sermon archive, events, weekly bulletins, articles, prayer wall, and a block page builder. 12 interface languages, three themes, self-hosted on Cloudflare. A Church4Christ edition.
features: **Sermon archive** with search, speakers, and series.
**Events and announcements** on a public calendar.
**Weekly bulletins** built and published from the admin area.
**Bilingual articles** and printable **prayer sheets**.
**Prayer wall.** Visitors send prayer requests; staff receive and care for them in the admin area.
**Fellowship directory.**
**Block page builder** for custom pages, with images stored in Cloudflare R2.
**12 interface languages**, including English and Simplified Chinese; each church turns on the ones it needs, and readers can switch Chinese text to Traditional with one tap.
**Three themes with light and dark modes,** all from design tokens, so your colors stay consistent.
**Staff sign in by magic link,** with no passwords to manage.
limits: Production email (sign-in links, prayer request notices) needs an email provider; see the main repo's cost notes before deploying.
This edition starts with website features only. Membership, volunteers, groups, and check-in are part of Church4Christ too and can be turned on later in **Settings → Modules**.
editions.demo: Choose **Visit the church website** to browse the public pages, or choose **Content editor** to try updating content.
